'''DecipherCon 1999 Gauntlet''' was a Star Wars CCG side event at [[DecipherCon 1999]] (11–14 November 1999, Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia). [[Matt Lush]] won, out of 9 players over 4 games.<ref name="dc99sw30_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW30_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: The Gauntlet Dual Format], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000602202806/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW30_1.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Side event (The Gauntlet Dual Format)
* '''Date:''' 11–14 November 1999
* '''Site:''' Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia
* '''Players:''' 9
